topics.title: Multi-Stage Dockerfiles & Minimal Image Construction
topics.objective: Build secure, minimal production container images by separating compilation stages from runtime distroless layers.
topics.example: FROM golang:1.22 AS builder ... FROM gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12
topics.exercise: Author a multi-stage Dockerfile for a Python web app reducing image size below 80MB without root privileges.

topics.title: Layer Caching Strategies & Dependency Pinning
topics.objective: Speed up CI/CD build pipelines by ordering Dockerfile instructions from least to most frequently changing.
topics.example: COPY requirements.txt . ; RUN pip install -r requirements.txt ; COPY . .
topics.exercise: Restructure a build script to optimize Docker layer cache re-use during frequent code commits.

topics.title: Container Networking & Multi-Service Docker Compose
topics.objective: Orchestrate local development environments with isolated bridge networks and persistent storage volumes.
topics.exercise: Write a docker-compose.yml launching an API, PostgreSQL database, and Redis cache with healthchecks.

topics.title: Container Hardening: Non-Root Users & Read-Only Rootfs
topics.objective: Eliminate container breakout vulnerabilities by dropping capabilities and running unprivileged user IDs.
topics.exercise: Harden a production container manifest by dropping all Linux capabilities and mounting tmpfs for temporary files.

topics.title: Image Scanning, Vulnerability Patching & Registry Signing
topics.objective: Scan images for CVEs using Trivy/Clair and sign artifacts with Cosign before production deployment.
topics.exercise: Integrate an automated Trivy security vulnerability gate failing builds on unpatched Critical CVEs.
